title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - Role
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/Role. A codelist containing the various roles a device can take: producer, consumer, and storage. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Role'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCommodity.description: Relationship. An indication of which commodity this Role is a consumer, producer, or storer of. References an external/core-SAREF concept (Commodity) not itself translated in this candidate.

hasRoleType.description: Property. The type of this specific role Controlled vocabulary (RoleType).
